archive: archive/ holds past editions: read only, never run; to rerun one, use the old release install.
step: step 2 METRICS of AGENTS.md: find the code by words, then read each hit with metric_brief_v2
question: Which metric or value code says what my idea needs, and where is its card?
usage_from_code: python3 -B where_v3.py <code, name or words> [--kind metric|code] [--n 5] [--safe] [--settings <settings file>]

commands.name: find
commands.does: searches the metric tables of this Alarm folder for a code, a name or words of a meaning and prints the best hits, one per code

args.name: --settings
args.meaning: optional: this machine's settings file, checked by _tools/settings_v1.py (the tool reads no data with it); a missing or refused file is refused, exit 2

args.name: <code, name or words>
args.meaning: a code (A1.S08), a name or words of its meaning; one argument, quoted when it has spaces

args.name: --kind
args.meaning: metric: METRICS_V1 (the LAB.* readings too), the HL candidates and the rows of the register METRICS_V2 that both lack; code: the value catalogues CTX, EPI, STAMP, FEED and LIVELAYER; none: both

args.name: --n
args.meaning: hits to print, 5 by default; it prints no word when more exist, so ask for more (R7 F15)

args.name: --safe
args.meaning: as where_v2: leaves out register rows (this edition has none)

args.name: --check
args.meaning: refused here, exit 2: the team map check stays in where_v2, in the dev tree

commands.writes: nothing: it prints its hits (read only)

refuses.when: NOT FOUND: no table holds the words; the line names the tables searched
REFUSED: no words (it prints its usage), --check, a settings file that is missing or refused, a metric table missing from this Alarm folder

rules: read only: it reads the metric tables inside this Alarm folder and prints; it reads no market data
a hit is a pointer, not a reading: read every code with metric_brief_v2.py before it goes in a rule
it prints only --n hits (5 by default) and says nothing when more exist: ask for --n 50 (R7 F15)
a metric the register METRICS_V2 marks DROPPED says DROPPED after its code, and DROPPED rows may come first (R7 F07); a card not in this Alarm folder says GONE TODAY
it prints no gate status: CAUTION and STOP come from metric_brief_v2, and the COUNT job gate reads tables neither tool reads (DEF_TEMPLATE_V4.md, The metric gate)
dry_run_data: planted by _tools/tests/test_agent_docs_v1.py: {SETTINGS} its settings file; the metric tables are this Alarm folder's own
